temporal_events.lifecycle_applicability: all Monitoring objects where event occurs
temporal_events.ownership: Monitoring Office for Monitoring records; source office for source timestamps
temporal_events.required_precision: ISO-8601 UTC with deterministic sequence tie-breaker
